title: DocBook

books.title: Systems Programming & Software Architecture Foundations with C++
books.subtitle: An architecture-first, runtime-first guide using C++ as the teaching language
books.description: For intermediate developers who can write code but want to understand what is actually happening when their code runs — and why software is built the way it is.

parts.title: Part 1 — What Programming Actually Is
parts.summary: The substrate. How programs become processes, what the CPU and memory really are, what the OS does on your behalf, and how source code becomes machine code. By the end you have an unbroken mental model from the program counter up to source code.
